caption: The drawing is composed on a beige or off-white background and features two separate illustrations. The upper part of the drawing contains a rectangular frame with a finely detailed, symmetrical collar design drawn in black or gray pencil or ink, with small floral or leaf patterns along the edge and the label "½ actual size" written below it. The lower part of the drawing shows a larger, more detailed view of a section of embroidered or lace fabric, again in shades of black or gray. This section displays a scalloped edge adorned with larger flower motifs and multiple leaves or oval shapes stemming from curving branches throughout the design, with shading used to highlight the texture and depth of the embroidery. In the bottom right corner, the name "G. L. Sabin" is written, possibly indicating the artist or designer. The left side of the paper shows some discoloration or stains.
title: Embroidered Linen Collar
